_comment: Main campaign questline: 'The Ohio Compact'. Player unites or conquers the valley.
title: The Ohio Compact
description: The old order collapsed. Ten ethnicities hold the Ohio River Valley. You will unite them — by diplomacy or by force.

quests.name: Awakening
quests.description: Create your character. Choose your ethnicity, background, and starting city.

quests.name: First Blood
quests.description: Prove yourself. Win a street tournament or clear a gang hideout.

quests.name: The Compact
quests.description: Three faction leaders will meet. Earn their trust — or their fear.
objectives: Reach 50 relation with 3 faction leaders OR defeat 3 faction parties

quests.name: Rising Power
quests.description: Your name spreads. Build your strength. Others will notice.

quests.name: The Choice
quests.description: The valley must unite. Will you be diplomat or conqueror?
objectives: Choose: Diplomacy path (ally 5 factions) OR Conquest path (capture 3 settlements)

quests.name: United Valley
quests.description: The Ohio River Valley stands united under your banner. The work begins.
